arguments.value: This agreement is between EWSD 1, LLC, d/b/a SHI FARMS (“Shi Farms”) and Gridiron BioNutrients, Inc. (“Gridiron”). Shi Farms agreed to sell, and Gridiron agreed to buy, 30,000 pounds of hemp biomass for $5.00 per pound, totaling $150,000. The biomass had to meet quality standards, including at least 6% CBD/CBDA, less than 3% THC, and no listed contaminants. Payment was due when the agreement was executed, and Shi Farms would then quarantine the product until delivery. Shi Farms would ship samples to a lab chosen by Gridiron if testing was needed, and would deliver the biomass to a processor chosen by Gridiron. The agreement could be terminated by either party at any time before delivery. Gridiron agreed to indemnify Shi Farms for certain claims and losses. The agreement is governed by Colorado law and any disputes must be litigated in Colorado state court.
